gloss_en: "his Torah" (torato) — the Torah that becomes the person's own possession (per Avodah Zarah 19a on Psalms 1:2: first 'the Torah of God,' then 'his Torah'); the internalized, revealed level of Torah corresponding to na'aseh ('we will do') and 'the revealed things belong to us,' in contrast to torat Hashem, the hidden nishma level
